verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a built-in ASC 718 Analysis Report that uses a Black-Scholes model to produce grant- and tranche-level expense breakdowns. Reports can be exported to Excel, a format suited to handing to accountants. The report is limited to the Scale Plan, and a help-center update FAQ describes customers transitioning to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which raises continuity questions for this capability. Missing for 10: evidence that the output is audit-ready (assumption documentation, forfeiture handling, journal-entry detail), independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on the equity product's ongoing availability.
